sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Review of the grammar and language systems from Units 1–9.

Vagyok and vagy are the 1st- and 2nd-person forms of lenni ('to be') and are always spoken aloud — it's only the 3rd person that Hungarian drops (ő Anna, not ő van Anna), so don't extend that omission back onto yourself or 'you'. A könyveim itt vannak pulls together two more of Units 1–9's threads at once: the plural -k on könyv and the 1st-person-singular possessive -m, stacked on the same noun.
